DLC2302:3:t_2:83.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ジャンゴ$$, $$クロス$$, $$お菊$$! And $$先生$$ too!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:84.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「J-just because you've brought more people...!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:85.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「You can't fight us with that little girl to protect!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:86.en:
$$安$$
「If you've got time to worry about that, worry about yourselves.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:90.en:
$$お菊$$
「It's special $$超合金Ｚ$$ thread. It was wasted on the likes of you, though.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:92.en:
$$お菊$$
「I'm just glad you aren't hurt, $$マッキー$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:93.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, everyone from $$くろがね屋$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:94.en:
$$クロス$$
「Don't mention it. We couldn't let anyone run wild on our turf, either.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:95.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「But, $$正太郎$$... I can't say I approve of you acting alone.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:97.en:
$$安$$
「You knew $$ブランチ$$ members were hiding around here, didn't you? That's why you came alone, right?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:99.en:
$$安$$
「Your sense of responsibility is admirable. But there are adults here too.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:100.en:
$$安$$
「Don't push yourself. At times like this, you can rely on us too.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:102.en:
$$マッキー$$
「$$安$$! Please don't blame $$正太郎$$! He was...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:103.en:
$$安$$
「I-I'm not angry at him, $$マッキー$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:104.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, $$マッキー$$. $$安$$ is saying this because he cares about me.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:106.en:
$$正太郎$$
「More importantly, I doubt these were all the $$ブランチ$$ members. There could be some where $$ワッ太$$ and the others are...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:107.en:
$$クロス$$
「You don't need to worry about that.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:108.en:
$$お菊$$
「That's right. We've arranged some backup for them too.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:115.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$熱海$$ is my hometown. I'm not about to let crooks do whatever they want here.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:117.en:
$$柿小路$$
「You really saved us, $$甲児$$. When those $$ブランチ$$ members showed up, I didn't know what would happen.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:118.en:
$$厚井$$
「But when did you get back to Japan?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:119.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just now. The $$くろがね五人衆$$ contacted me, so I stopped by here before heading to the $$極東支部$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:120.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Aw, man... $$甲児$$ stole all the glory.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:121.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Don't say that, President. If $$甲児$$ hadn't come, $$サチ子$$ and $$しげる$$ would have been in danger too.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:123.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't mention it, $$ワッ太$$. ...But I won't always be around.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:125.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I can't stay a kid forever, either. I'll train my body so I don't lose to guys like them.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:126.en:
$$甲児$$
「As long as you understand, that's fine. I've got nothing else to say.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:128.en:
$$ボス$$
「The bastards got desperate and brought out their robots!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:129.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ワッ太$$... Where's $$トライダー$$?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:130.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course I brought it with me.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:132.en:
$$サチ子$$
「Are you going to fight those guys?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:133.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait here, $$しげる$$, $$サチ子$$! Your big brother will go take care of those crooks in no time!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:134.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's the spirit! Let's go, $$ワッ太$$!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:3.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Damn it! Now our comeback is...!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Just concentrate on escaping for now! If we get out of here, there's still hope...」

DLC2302:3:t_3:7.en:
$$安$$
「Now that you haven't got your robots, let's settle this with our fists.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:8.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Though in our case, calling it a fight with our bare bodies is a bit of a stretch.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:11.en:
$$お菊$$
「Oh, dear... Calling for help? You're a disgrace to outlaws everywhere.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:12.en:
$$クロス$$
「Looks like we'll have to beat some guts into you from scratch.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:13.en:
$$安$$
「You said it. Let's take our time enjoying this.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「...You two must be tired. Let's have a soak and wash off the sweat.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But is it all right...? $$クロス$$ looked like he had something to say to us.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's fine, it's fine. The $$くろがね五人衆$$ always want to lecture any young person they see.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't worry, $$正太郎$$. If you think you've made a mistake, just try again.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:24.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's how you grow up, and one day you'll be an adult.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:25.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hey, now I sound just like one of $$クロス$$'s lectures.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:26.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is that how you grew up, too, $$甲児$$?」

DLC2302:3:t_3:27.en:
$$甲児$$
「Pretty much. As you know, at first I charged ahead on sheer enthusiasm and caused trouble for everyone.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「If I've gotten a little better, it's probably because every mistake taught me to stop and think a little more.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:29.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Will we... be able to do that too?」

DLC2302:3:t_3:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「Of course. You and $$ワッ太$$ are already far more responsible than I was in elementary school.」

DLC2302:3:t_3:31.en:
$$安$$
「Hey, you lot! Quit chatting and get in the bath already!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:32.en:
$$安$$
「$$クロス$$ says he's throwing a banquet to thank you for protecting $$熱海$$!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:33.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Maybe that was what $$クロス$$ wanted to tell us, rather than giving us a lecture...!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「In that case, let's get in the bath! $$安$$, scrub my back for me!」

DLC2302:3:t_3:36.en:
$$安$$
「Leave it to me! I'll give the heroes who saved $$熱海$$ some special service too!」

review.context: The Kurogane Five rescue Makki and teach Shotaro to rely on adults. Kouji saves Watta's family and joins him against the robots. Afterward the boys discuss growing up at the hot springs.
decisions: Django's bare-body joke refers to the Kurogane staff's modified bodies.
Cross and Yasu's threatened correction of the criminals retains their rough gangster manner.
Shotaro's isolated 'But... I...' is a deliberate interrupted thought retained as such.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
